dct_description_sm:
This database contains 67,200 defects, each individually exported in STL format (with dimensional values provided in millimeters).

These defects were used for CAD model augmentation in X-ray computed tomography (CT) simulations presented in the publication: Reliability of CT Digital Twins for Defect Segmentation and Probability of Detection Estimation in AM Parts
dct_title_s: STL Defects Database for the publication "Reliability of CT Digital Twins for Defect Segmentation and Probability of Detection Estimation in AM Parts"
